name_zh: 德川家康：从三河浪人到天下人的『三重制衡体系』与动态平稳治理范式
name_en: Tokugawa Ieyasu: From Mikawa Wanderer to Shogun of All Japan — the 'Triple Balance System' and Dynamic Stability Governance Paradigm
description_zh: 德川家康（Tokugawa Ieyasu，1543-1616）是日本江户幕府初代征夷大将军，日本历史上统一时间最长（265年）的和平时代的奠基者。他从织田信长的家臣、丰臣秀吉的家臣中崛起，经历长筱之战、关原合战（1600年），最终建立江户幕府。其核心思维贡献在于将「动态制衡」工程化为可操作的和平治理体系——通过「大御所政治」（隐居后以江户为权力中心）实现双核制衡，通过「参勤交代」（大名定期到江户述职并留家属为人质）制度化解地方军事威胁，通过「武家诸法度」和「禁中并公家诸法度」建立朝廷与幕府的宪法级关系框架。德川家康的独特之处在于他不是依靠单一军事胜利，而是通过制度设计使天下稳定「自动再生产」。他是Protreplet中模式34（制度化制衡法）在日本政治思想传统中的唯一完整样本，也是模式7（战略预判法）在「长期权力布局」场景的独特代表。
description_en: Tokugawa Ieyasu (1543-1616) was the first Shogun of Japan's Edo shogunate, founder of Japan's longest unified peaceful era (265 years). Rising from being vassal to Oda Nobunaga and Toyotomi Hideyoshi, he survived Battles of Nagashino and Sekigahara (1600), ultimately establishing the Edo shogunate. His core thinking contribution lies in engineering 'dynamic balance' into an operable peaceful governance system — through 'Daijo-sei politics' (retiring and ruling from Edo as power center) achieving dual-core balance, through 'Sankin-kotai' (daimyo periodic reporting to Edo with families held as hostages) institutionalizing local military threat neutralization, through 'Buke Shohatto' and 'Kin-chū kuge-shohatto' establishing constitutional-level court-shogunate relations. Ieyasu's uniqueness is that he did not rely on single military victory but designed institutions making peace 'automatically reproduce'. He is the only complete sample of mode 34 (Institutionalized Checks) in Japanese political thought and the unique representative of mode 7 (Strategic Prediction) in 'long-term power positioning' within Protreptic.
reason_zh: 德川家康填补了Protreptic在「制度化制衡体系」领域的日本空白。他是模式34（制度化制衡法）的唯一完整样本，展示了如何通过参勤交代、大御所政治和武家诸法度三大制度设计将军事胜利转化为「自动再生产」的和平体系；也是模式7（战略预判法）在「长期权力布局与制度锁定」场景的唯一日本代表。他的「天下人」治理模式对现代组织管理中的「制度锁定（institutional lock-in）」概念具有直接启发价值。
reason_en: Tokugawa Ieyasu fills Protreptic's Japanese gap in 'institutionalized balance systems'. He is the only complete sample of mode 34 (Institutionalized Checks), demonstrating how Sankin-kotai, Daijo-sei politics and Buke Shohatto three institutional designs convert military victory into 'automatically reproducing' peace system; also the sole Japanese representative of mode 7 (Strategic Prediction) in 'long-term power positioning and institutional lock-in'. His 'Shogun of All Japan' governance model has direct heuristic value for modern organizational management's 'institutional lock-in' concept.
steps_zh: 第1步（模式7战略预判法）：长期权力布局——在关原合战前20年即开始识别「制度锁定的必要性」，不急于称征，而是以清洲会议→小牧长久手之战→大阪阵→关原合战的渐进路径积累合法性，最终在1603年接受征夷大将军称号时已有充分制度基础
第2步（模式34制度化制衡法）：参勤交代制度设计——将地方大名的经济负担（定期往返江户、维持两处宅邸）转化为对中央的依赖，以「家属留居江户」作为人质机制，使任何单一藩国无法单独挑战幕府权威
第3步（模式12系统思维）：大御所政治双核体系——1605年将将军之位让予儿子秀忠后，以「大御所」身份在江户继续掌控实权，形成「表（将军）—里（大御所）」双核制衡结构，确保权力平稳过渡而不出现真空
第4步（模式31框架效应法）：朝廷—幕府关系重构——通过《禁中并公家诸法度》将天皇定义为「学术文化权威」而非政治权力中心，以「武家诸法度」规范各藩大名行为，将封建关系重新框架为制度化的等级制
第5步（范式固化）：天下平稳再生产——将「战略预判→制度制衡→双核治理→关系重构」四环沉淀为可复制的封建和平治理母板，使日本获得长达265年无大规模内战的稳定期
steps_en: Step 1 (Mode 7 Strategic Prediction): Long-term power positioning — 20 years before Sekigahara, begin recognizing 'necessity of institutional lock-in', not rushing to claim Shogun title, but accumulating legitimacy through gradual path: Oda Nobunaga's Kiyosu Conference → Komaki-Nagasakate War → Osaka Campaign → Sekigahara, receiving Shogun title in 1603 with sufficient institutional foundation

Step 2 (Mode 34 Institutionalized Checks): Sankin-kotai system design — convert local daimyo economic burden (periodic travel to Edo, maintaining two residences) into central dependence, using 'families residing in Edo' as hostage mechanism, making any single domain unable to challenge shogunate authority alone

Step 3 (Mode 12 Systems Thinking): Daijo-sei dual-core system — after abdicating to son Hidetada in 1605, continue controlling actual power as 'Daijo-sei (retired Shogun)' in Edo, forming 'formal (Shogun) — hidden (Daijo-sei)' dual-core balance structure, ensuring smooth power transition without vacuum

Step 4 (Mode 31 Framing Effect): Court-shogunate relations reconstruction — through Kin-chū kuge-shohatto define Emperor as 'academic-cultural authority' rather than political power center, through Buke Shohatto regulate daimyo behavior, reframing feudal relations into institutionalized hierarchy

Step 5 (Paradigm Solidification): Peaceful reproduction of All Japan — condense 'strategic prediction→institutional balance→dual-core governance→relations reconstruction' into replicable feudal peace governance template, granting Japan 265 years of stability without large-scale internal war
expected_zh: 掌握德川家康从「军事胜利者」到「制度设计者」的根本转型；理解参勤交代、大御所政治和武家诸法度三大制度的系统关联及其对日本长期和平的贡献；评估其「制度锁定」模式在现代组织管理中的持续价值。
expected_en: Master Tokugawa Ieyasu's fundamental transformation from 'military victor' to 'institutional designer'; understand systemic connections among Sankin-kotai, Daijo-sei politics and Buke Shohatto three institutions and their contribution to Japan's long peace; evaluate the continuing value of his 'institutional lock-in' model in modern organizational management.
case_zh: 关原合战（1600年）：德川家康在战后并未立即称征，而是花了3年时间（1600-1603）系统重构权力格局——将亲丰臣的大名调离要害地区（加藤清正转封熊本、岛津家转封萨摩），将亲德川的同盟者安置在战略要冲（福岛正则控制丰前、黑田长政控制筑后）。1605年让位给儿子秀忠后，以「大御所」身份在江户继续掌控实权。1615年大阪夏之阵彻底消灭丰臣家后，立即颁布《武家诸法度》（11条）和《禁中并公家诸法度》，将大名权力制度化约束。其中「参勤交代」制度要求全国200余位大名每年交替在江户述职，将经济负担转化为政治约束。这一系列制度设计使日本获得长达265年的和平，被称为「德川太平」。
case_en: Battle of Sekigahara (1600): After victory, Tokugawa Ieyasu did not immediately claim Shogun title but spent 3 years (1600-1603) systematically restructuring power — relocating Toyotomi-aligned daimyo from strategic positions (Kato Kiyomasa transferred to Kumamoto, Shimazu family to Satsuma), placing Tokugawa allies at strategic chokepoints (Fukushima Masanori controlled Buzen, Kuroda Nagamasa controlled Chikugo). In 1605 he abdicated to son Hidetada, then continued controlling actual power as 'Daijo-sei (retired Shogun)' in Edo. In 1615 Osaka Summer Campaign completely eliminating Toyotomi family, he immediately promulgated Buke Shohatto (11 articles) and Kin-chū kuge-shohatto, institutionalizing daimyo power constraints. The 'Sankin-kotai' system requiring 200+ daimyo to alternate serving in Edo annually converted economic burden into political constraint. This series of institutional designs granted Japan 265 years of peace, called 'Tokugawa Peace'.
cross_cultural_impact: Established 265-year peaceful era enabling cultural flourishing (Ukiyo-e, Kabuki, haiku); Sankin-kotai became model of institutionalized governance in pre-modern East Asia
